tagline: A bolster for their chin, and room to roll out to full length without leaving the bed.
lead: Your dog can prop their chin on the bolster, then stretch right out without ever leaving the bed.
value: It has what a cheap bed leaves out: profiled foam, a waterproof membrane over it, a heavy-duty zip you will use, and a base that doesn't skate.
intro: Blackthorn is an orthopaedic bolster dog bed for large dogs, with a profiled egg-crate foam base, a waterproof inner membrane, a zipped plush cover and a non-slip base. Large and XL, in Grey or Dark Grey.
points: The raised bolster gives their chin somewhere to rest without enclosing every side.
Profiled foam cushions the whole sleeping surface.
Sits between the plush cover and the foam, so a spill or wet coat stays off the foam.
The plush cover comes off for washing, with a zip you will actually use.
Helps keep the bed in place on smooth floors.
best_for: Large dogs who switch between leaning against an edge and stretching right out.
fit_note: Sizes are outside measurements and the bolster takes up some of that, so between sizes, size up. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm.
care: Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
